messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/stream (hosted). SLO breach. Paging oncall now. Metrics: p95=420ms, p99=2.8s, streaming stalls observed.

sanjay: got the page, I'm oncall. pulling graphs now. any customer-facing impact?

cody: CX reports a handful of customers see hung streams / long initial response times, some abandoned sessions. Ticket flow increasing.

maria: seeing increased queuing in the runtime. tail latency aligns with recent precision-profile rollout (int8-calib v3) ~10m ago.

li: confirmed: quant calib job applied to several model variants. CPU/KV usage looks normal but GPU idle->hot spikes correlate with stall windows.

jess: assigning incident lead to maria for now. Maria, can you confirm whether a rollback is safe?

maria: I need 3-5m to check calibration flags and whether we have a canary rollback prepared. If rollback unsafe, we can enable model fallback to fp16 per routing policy.

sanjay: instructing traffic route: route streaming requests to fp16-fallback pool and isolate quantized variant. Cody, tell affected customers we're investigating and may ask them to retry.

cody: copy. I posted a brief status to the affected customers channel.

maria: quick checks:
```
# show active precision profile
curl -sS https://internal-console/api/v1/configs/precision | jq .active
# result: "int8-calib-v3"
```
I can flip to int8-calib-v2 (older) or disable precision for streaming route. recommend disable for streaming and do a controlled rollback of calib-v3.

li: before rollback, note that int8 path introduced a dequantization step that increases KV cache miss latency in certain long-context flows. That could explain stalls for streaming.

maria: running the rollback now (will prefer routing change first):
```
# route change
curl -X POST https://internal-console/api/v1/routing/update -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","policy":"fp16-fallback","immediate":true}'
# kubectl command to pin variant (if needed)
kubectl patch svc stream-model -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"precision":"fp16"}}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-change/1799991234 by maria — rolling update to routing table (3 clusters).

maria: routing change applied to 3 clusters. monitoring p95/p99 now.

sanjay: any rollbacks to model assets? or just routing?

maria: just routing for immediate mitigation. I'll initiate calib-v3 rollback after we stabilize.

(2m later)

maria: immediate results: p95 down to ~200ms, p99 trending down from 2.8s -> 760ms. streaming stall count dropped ~85%.

cody: customer update sent: "We applied a mitigation to restore streaming performance; we're continuing root cause analysis and will follow up."

jess: good. let's keep canary rollback plan ready. Li, can you prepare a calibration breakdown so we can repro in staging?

li: on it — collecting calibration logs and KV cache traces now. suspected change: new dequant op ordering + a micro-optimization that skipped a prefetched KV path under high seq-length.

maria: plan for 30m: 1) keep routing to fp16-fallback for streaming 2) rollback int8-calib-v3 from prod config 3) run small canary of rollback on one region 4) validate tail metrics and then full rollout if stable.

sanjay: agree. set status -> INCIDENT: Mitigated (routing fallback). Next step: rollback canary in 10m. Handing off steady-state monitoring to li for the next 25m, I'll remain incident lead for now.

deploy-bot: canary rollback scheduled: precision-rollback-canary/1799991234 at +10m (region-us-west-2).

(10m later)

maria: canary rollback applied in us-west-2. Observing metrics: p99 reduced to 420ms in canary region. No new errors. Rolling to remaining regions in 5m.

li: verification logs attached (snippet):
```
[us-west-2] p99_before=2.6s p99_after=0.42s
streaming_stalls_before=190/min streaming_stalls_after=12/min
```

jess: rolling. Ensure config audit and postmortem owners. @maria @li lead RCA; @sanjay to coordinate pagerduty notes; @cody to compile customer timeline.

maria: full rollback complete. Post-rollback checks look good. Keeping a watch window for 1h.

sanjay: switching status to RESOLVED -> mitigated. We'll keep incident open for RCA and postmortem. Handoff to next oncall (ryan) for watch window. Key actions for next oncall:
- monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall rate
- do not re-enable int8-calib-v3 until QA signoff
- collect calibration artifacts and perf traces

cody: I've updated customers and CS thread. No escalations to legal so far.

li: preliminary root cause hypothesis: int8-calib-v3 introduced a subtle dequant order + cache prefetech skip under long-context streaming which led to hot GPU bursts and KV miss tail spikes. Calibration rollout lacked a targeted streaming canary.

maria: immediate remediation: revert precision profile, add gating to calibration rollouts (explicit streaming canary), and add regression test in perf CI for long context streaming with quantized paths.

jess: thanks team. Postmortem owners: maria, li. ETA initial draft in 48h.

sanjay: closing handoff. If anything regresses ping pager immediately. :thumbsup:
